associated_VHbb.order: central, down, up, separately fitted total uncertainties; Fig.12

VBF_WH_same_SRminus.region: SR-minus. Common W decay and H->bb, pT(bb)>250 GeV, delta y(jj)>4.4, mbb 105-145 GeV. Combine prefit signal prediction and SM signal in same SR, never use the positive-analysis SR.

surplus_definition: Assume mu_WH <= p^2+delta_W, mu_ZH <= q^2+delta_Z in the associated fits; the positive deviations include accepted ggZH, loop, fermion-current changes, branching/efficiency and their relative template changes. Illustrative total transfer budgets, not measured errors. The DY fraction alone does not bound enhancement of ggZH or a varying top Yukawa.
scope: One narrow CP-even h and two real SM-like tensor structures with common accepted production vectors, ordinary gauge and current inputs in the declared window. Any further coherent contribution is bounded separately; all remaining incoherent backgrounds nonnegative. No assumption of full polarization tagging or independent ATLAS samples.
